halt.translation:
n. 停止, 立定, 休息
vt. 使停止, 使立定
vi. 立定, 停止, 蹒跚, 踌躇, 有缺点
[计] 停止

halted.translation: v. （使）停下来( halt的过去式和过去分词 )

halter.definition:
n. rope or canvas headgear for a horse, with a rope for leading
n. a woman's top that fastens behind the back and neck leaving the back and arms uncovered
n. either of the rudimentary hind wings of dipterous insects; used for maintaining equilibrium during flight
halter.translation:
n. 缰绳, 笼头
[法] 绞刑, 绞索

halter-tops.translation: (halter-top 的复数) 露背装, 三角背心

haltere.definition: n either of the rudimentary hind wings of dipterous insects; used for maintaining equilibrium during flight

haltered.translation: v. （马的）笼头, 缰绳( halter的过去式和过去分词 ); （女用的在颈和背后系带的）袒肩露背上装

halteres.definition: n. pl. Balancers; the rudimentary hind wings of Diptera.
halteres.translation: n. （马的）笼头, 缰绳( halter的名词复数 ); （女用的在颈和背后系带的）袒肩露背上装

haltering.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Halter
haltering.translation: v. （马的）笼头, 缰绳( halter的现在分词 ); （女用的在颈和背后系带的）袒肩露背上装

halters.definition:
n. rope or canvas headgear for a horse, with a rope for leading
n. a rope that is used by a hangman to execute persons who have been condemned to death by hanging
n. a woman's top that fastens behind the back and neck leaving the back and arms uncovered
halters.translation:
n. （马的）笼头, 缰绳( halter的复数形式 ); （女用的在颈和背后系带的）袒肩露背上装
v. （马的）笼头, 缰绳( halter的第三人称单数 ); （女用的在颈和背后系带的）袒肩露背上装

halting.definition: s. fragmentary or halting from emotional strain
halting.translation: a. 跛的, 蹒跚的, 犹豫的

haltingly.translation: adv. 迟疑不决地；犹豫地

haltom city.translation: 荷登姆市（美国得克萨斯州北部城市）

halton hills.translation: 霍尔藤山市（加拿大安大略省东南部城市）

halts.definition:
n the state of inactivity following an interruption
n the event of something ending
n an interruption or temporary suspension of progress or movement
v cause to stop
v come to a halt, stop moving
v stop from happening or developing
v stop the flow of a liquid
halts.translation: v. （使）停下来( halt的第三人称单数 )
